newsitem.title: USA: Haagen-Daz offering low-fat ice cream.
newsitem.headline: Haagen-Daz offering low-fat ice cream.

text.p: Haagen-Daz said Friday it will introduce a new low-fat ice cream line this month.
Haagen-Daz is a unit of Pillsbury, which is the North American-based subsidiary of Grand Metropolitan Plc.
The new low-fat ice cream varieties include vanilla, chocolate, strawberry and coffee fudge. Each flavor has three grams of fat or less per serving.
The product introduction will be supported by an advertising and promotion campaign, including television advertising, consumer couponing, direct mail, in-store sampling and merchandising.
The suggested retail price is $3.09 a pint.
